verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.metronome.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as Markdown links. The doc pages themselves are served as .md URLs, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published at /openapi.json, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering (e.g., an llms-full.txt or agent usage guidance), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
